'''Block 1138 Sable''' was the room block located in the center of the [[Black Level]]&mdash;the lowest of the three passenger levels on the ''[[Errant Venture/Legends|Errant Venture]]'', located just above [[the Mines]]. The block was occupied by the ship's security force and was much nicer than the rest of the Black Level, which was mostly holds, workshops and stripped passenger cabins.

{{Loc-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Block 1138 Sable is one of many [[1138 (easter egg)|references]] throughout ''Star Wars'' media to [[George Lucas]]' first feature film, [[Wikipedia:THX 1138|''THX 1138'']].
